# Gateway

## Configuration

The service reads these environment variables:

- `GW_PORT` (default `8080`): listen port.
- `GW_LOG_LEVEL` (default `info`): one of debug, info, warn.
- `GW_TIMEOUT_MS` (default `3000`): upstream timeout.
- `GW_TLS` (default `off`): enable TLS.

## Notes

Set `GW_DEBUG=1` only in development; it has no default and is not supported in production.
